Section3 proves weighted-norm continuity and difference quotients before higher Leibniz differentiation.
Bell-polynomial bounds, alpha!<=m! and2^(m-1) ordered compositions give the stated Gevrey order.
Theorems2.7–2.8 derive a uniform positive weight margin, at the stated L2-existence premise boundary.
Lemma4.2 proves consistent extensions and range identity using the nearby projection and density.
Lemmas2.1–2.3 and4.3 yield the holomorphic bracket inverse on both fixed weighted spaces; complex projection interpretation is excluded.
Proposition4.1 absorbs logarithmic powers in a stronger fixed norm and proves multiplier holomorphy.
Section4.4 differentiates the compactly supported mean-value vector and uses interior holomorphic estimates; no spatial derivative of delta is taken.
Theorem1.3 gives R_J independent of S and ell; the prefactor can depend on them, and spatial control is interior.
Section5 spends successive positive margins before transferring logarithmic multipliers and removing cutoffs.
Recent Remark2.5 and Chen pages4–6 support the uniform cover/localization/absorption argument at explicitly cited premises; direct twist identity passes.
Page3 radial integral and opposite one-sided kernel derivatives reconstructed directly; bounded densities are not L-infinity continuous at0.
Fixed-degree selected-space Gram analyticity does not provide degree-uniform control or control changing multiplier ideals; P20 stays open.
